APPROVE
The control flow is equivalent: print rules are skipped, the qualifies/focus-state check and the removing-rule vs. key/universal targeting check are preserved, and declarations are still checked in the same order with the same short-circuiting. `Replaced` now scores about 7 against a threshold of 15, and it only uses LINQ calls (`Where`, `Select`, `Any`) the file already relies on, so it should still build.
